raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "26.1.0"

package:
  name: structlog
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/s/structlog/structlog-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f63a716cbd1b1291cf7661de7794b455acfa4c43c5bcf1630e6ad5ddc1adb3b7

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed --no-cache-dir -vvv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - hatchling
    - hatch-vcs
    - hatch-fancy-pypi-readme >=22.8.0
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - typing-extensions

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - structlog
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  license: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
  summary: Structured Logging for Python
  license_file:
    - LICENSE-MIT
    - LICENSE-APACHE
  homepage: http://www.structlog.org
  repository: https://github.com/hynek/structlog

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - vamega
    - aldanor
    - synapticarbors
